extensionDescription.message: Enable copying, text selection, and right-click menus on restricted webpages.
extensionDescription.description: The extension's description in the browser's extension list and store.

commandDescription.message: Enable copy and right click on the current page
commandDescription.description: The keyboard shortcut's name in the browser's keyboard shortcuts settings.

actionTitleActive.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button on a tab where copying and right click are enabled. The extension's name stays in English.

copyEnabled.description: What screen readers announce on the page once copying and right click are enabled.

optionsTitle.description: The settings page's title in the browser tab. The extension's name stays in English.

githubLink.message: GitHub repository, opens in a new tab
githubLink.description: Accessible name of the GitHub link in the settings page's header.

automaticSitesIntro.message: Automatically enable copying, text selection, and right click on the websites you add.
automaticSitesIntro.description: Text under the settings page's heading.

siteInputLabel.description: Accessible name of the field where a website's domain, such as example.com, is entered.

addSite.description: Button that adds the entered website.

noSites.description: Shown instead of the list when no website is added.

siteListLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of added websites.

remove.description: Button next to a website that removes it from the list.

removeSite.description: Accessible name of the Remove button next to a website.

permissionRemoved.description: A website in the list whose permission was taken back in the browser's settings.

siteAdded.description: Status after a website is added.

siteReEnabled.description: Status after a website in the list whose permission was removed is added again.

siteRemoved.description: Status after a website is removed.

siteAlreadyEnabled.description: Status when the entered website is already in the list.

invalidDomain.message: Enter a valid domain, such as example.com.
invalidDomain.description: Error when the entered text is not a website's domain.

permissionNotGranted.description: Error when the browser's permission prompt for the website is declined.

addFailed.message: The site could not be added.
addFailed.description: Error when adding a website fails.

removeFailed.message: The site could not be removed.
removeFailed.description: Error when removing a website fails.

loadFailed.message: The site list could not be loaded.
loadFailed.description: Error when the settings page cannot read the list of websites.
